Aether_Description: Aether Dungeons are located within structures resembling a parthenon in the sky. These have multiple floors, typically three, each with multiple rooms.
Roguelike_Description: Roguelike dungeon generates large underground roguelike dungeon structures. Layout, loot and size of the dungeons are random.
Doomlike_Description: Doomlike dungeons meant to resemble levels from retro "2 1/2d" first-person shooters, and was inspired by earlier dungeons mods and by Oblige (especially version 3.57), a random level generator for Doom.
BattleTower_Description: Battle tower adds a simple tower type dungeon for explore
DraylarBattleTower_Description: Just another type of battle tower
Smoofy_Description: DungeonMaze generates dungeons with a lot of cool and strange stuff in it. A small garden is always at the middle of dungeon.
Lich_Description: The Lich Tower is a landmark from the Twilight Forest mod. At the very top of this tower the Twilight Lich lives, rules, and performs sorcery. The Lich Tower has a large main room, and a bunch of smaller rooms stemming off of it.
Antman_Description: Antman dungeon has narrow, wild tunnels that seemingly go nowhere, but a huge stronghold will hide in it.
Castle_Description: Castle Dungeons are procedurally generated castles that all have a different appearance. This makes for an amazing variety of structures.
Castle_King_Head_Lore: Thou shall endeth this eternal twilight
